overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive study combining structural (language model) and functional (multi-agent communication) learning for NLG evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplication and inconsistent formatting. Key contributions include the reranker-based approach and analysis of different types of language drift (structural, semantic, pragmatic) in multi-agent communication systems.
